# OpenCyber Academy

OpenCyber Academy is a public collection of cybersecurity courses and books. Public lessons are available without an account. GitHub main is the editorial source of truth; a plan is not a lesson and a published draft is not necessarily an approved complete book.

- Website: https://opencyber.academy/
- Course catalog JSON: https://opencyber.academy/api/catalog
- FastAPI/OpenAPI documentation: https://opencyber.academy/api/docs
- Remote read-only MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://opencyber.academy/mcp
- AI connection guide: https://opencyber.academy/for-ai/
- Permanent authored lesson example: https://opencyber.academy/courses/rapid-1-month/incident-response-resilience/lessons/en/1/
- Sitemap of authored lesson pages: https://opencyber.academy/sitemap.xml
- Source repository: https://github.com/hiagokinlevi/OpenCyberAcademy
- Book standard: https://github.com/hiagokinlevi/OpenCyberAcademy/blob/main/BOOK_STANDARD.md
- Editorial production order: complete and review all English books first, then Portuguese, then Spanish. Begin other languages only after all three collections independently reach 100% verified completion under the book standard. Read the live rule via MCP resource open-cyber-academy://editorial-policy or tool get_editorial_policy; a manuscript or chapter count does not prove completion.

Use the catalog to choose a level and area, then GET /api/courses/{level}/{area}/{language} to list authored daily lessons and chapters. GET /api/lessons/{level}/{area}/{language}/{chapter} to read one lesson and its worked answers. Public HTML lessons use /courses/{level}/{area}/lessons/{language}/{chapter}/; full legacy chapters use /courses/{level}/{area}/chapters/{language}/{chapter}/. Supported catalog languages are en, pt, es, he, fr, ru, de, zh and ja, but availability differs by edition. Cite the returned original source URL when quoting the manuscript. Do not treat plan-only chapters as published lessons.
